title: Atacar el compilador de presión contra un snapshot vivo del repo
mission: Independently attack the new frontier-pressure compiler on a fresh repository snapshot using the persisted implementation bytes. Exercise its live-filesystem path, verify terminal/live-owned/stale classifications and guide signals against durable evidence, fail closed on malformed state, and materialize a bounded repair/verification successor only if a concrete weakness is found. Do not change product authority or production /w.
definition_of_done: A fresh main repository snapshot is recorded with exact source head/hash evidence.
The persisted scripts/compile-frontier-pressure.mjs bytes execute against that snapshot rather than only synthetic fixtures.
Observed frontier/launch/ownership/return signals are reconciled with exact durable refs and obvious misclassification is checked.
Malformed or ambiguous evidence does not silently become claimable/active authority.
Any concrete software-solvable weakness found becomes one deduplicated bounded successor; otherwise the return records independent PASS evidence and residual limits.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w promotion occurs.
